[LEXP.3.7.3] **Five of these members are this arithmetic and no other.** Let
$p = x \bmod 2^{64}$, the pattern read as an unsigned number, and let
$\mathrm{int}(v)$, for $0 \le v < 2^{64}$, be the `Int` whose pattern is $v$:
$v$ when $v < 2^{63}$, else $v - 2^{64}$.

| Member | Domain | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `x.bits(lo, w)` | $0 \le lo$, $1 \le w$, $lo + w \le 64$ | $\mathrm{int}(\lfloor p / 2^{lo} \rfloor \bmod 2^{w})$ |
| `x.sign_extend(w)` | $1 \le w \le 64$ | $u - 2^{w}$ when $u \ge 2^{w-1}$, else $u$, where $u = p \bmod 2^{w}$ |
| `x.swap_bytes(w)` | $w \in \{16, 32, 64\}$ | $\mathrm{int}\big(\sum_{i=0}^{n-1} b_i \, 2^{8(n-1-i)}\big)$, where $n = w / 8$ and $b_i = \lfloor p / 2^{8i} \rfloor \bmod 2^{8}$ |
| `x.leading_zeros` | every `x` | $64 - \lceil \log_2 (p + 1) \rceil$ |
| `x.trailing_zeros` | every `x` | the largest $k \le 64$ with $2^{k} \mid p$ |

The bits of `x` above the field do not reach the result. `bits` and
`swap_bytes` are non-negative unless $w = 64$; `x.bits(0, 64)` and
`x.sign_extend(64)` are `x`. Every argument is an `Int`, and a null receiver or
argument yields null ([LNUL.4.1]).

The compiler must lower each of these members to its own builtin, the receiver
first: `FN_BITS`, `FN_SIGN_EXTEND`, `FN_SWAP_BYTES`, `FN_LEADING_ZEROS` and
`FN_TRAILING_ZEROS` (`proto/builtin_fn.proto#BuiltinFn`).
